```yaml
name: Run Bun Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  bun-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: '8'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Install Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Start local testnet
        run: |
          pnpm run testnet:start &
          echo $! > testnet.pid
          # Wait for the testnet to be ready
          sleep 10

      - name: Run Bun tests
        run: bun test

      - name: Stop local testnet
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f testnet.pid ]; then
            kill $(cat testnet.pid) || true
          fi
```
